name: Crete, Greece

visa.notes: Financially independent person visa requires ~€2,000/mo income proof.

rent.notes: Crete Direct (Jul 2026): 2BR annual lets 570-920 EUR in Heraklion, 620-980 EUR in Chania, 510-820 EUR in Rethymno, cheaper in Ierapetra and villages; Spitogatos Q2 2026 asking rents 12.0 EUR/sqm Heraklion, 12.9 Chania, 13.2 Rethymno for small units. A pet-friendly 3BR or house with yard sits at the upper half of the range.

groceries.notes: Crete Direct (Jun 2026): 200-280 EUR per person at local supermarkets, with cheap street-market produce and olive oil; two adults about 470 EUR plus 100+ EUR/month of food for a large-breed dog. Food CPI +0.9% y/y Aug 2026.

sources.title: Crete Direct: Cost of Living in Crete 2026
Athens Times: How Much Does a Dog Really Cost in Greece in 2026
Trading Economics: Greece inflation September 2026

utilities.notes: Crete Direct (Jun 2026): electricity plus water 80-160 EUR/month for one person, peaking in July-August with AC, water rarely above 15 EUR; Expatistan Heraklion 125 EUR for two in 85 sqm (older data). Scaled for two adults in a 2-3BR and the November 2026 tariff rises (PPC green 0.169 EUR/kWh, others +30-76%).

sources.title: Crete Direct: Cost of Living in Crete 2026
Expatistan: utilities for 2 people in 85m2 flat in Heraklion

healthcare.notes: Crete Direct (Jun 2026): private health insurance for non-EU expats 80-150 EUR per person per month depending on age and cover; Feather (Apr 2026): basic 50-100 EUR, mid-range 125-250 EUR per person. Two 60-year-olds on basic-to-mid plans about 260 EUR; Heraklion and Chania have university/public hospitals and private clinics.

sources.title: Crete Direct: Cost of Living in Crete 2026

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from old template (health) to renters/contents cover. COSMOTE Insurance/Hellas Direct contents-only policies for tenants cost 18-54 EUR per year for 6,000-25,000 EUR of cover; sold nationally online.

transportation.notes: Car needed for most of Crete: fuel 1.85-2.00 EUR/L for about 800-1000 km/month, basic third-party insurance about 150-200 EUR/yr (national online quote, driver 36-65), road tax unchanged for 2026, maintenance; Heraklion city bus pass about 30 EUR and KTEL Heraklion-Chania 14 EUR one way. Transport CPI +11.3% y/y Sept 2026.

entertainment.notes: Cosmote/Nova fibre 100-300 Mbps 25-40 EUR, streaming about 30 EUR, dinner for two with wine 35-55 EUR three to four times a month (20-30% more in tourist areas), plus activities.

healthcare.system: Regional hospital in Heraklion (PAGNI) is largest on the island. Limited specialist care may require travel to Athens.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-12 weeks. Complex cases may need Athens referral.

pros: Warm climate with beautiful beaches and mountains
Excellent Cretan cuisine and food culture

cons.text: Island isolation - ferry or flights to mainland
